messages:
alex_k: Heads-up — onboarding run for reranker-v12-ptq shows consistent NDCG@10 drop vs fp16 baseline only when queries end with punctuation. small numbers: -2.3% NDCG@10, -1.1% MRR. anyone seen punctuation-driven shifts before?

maria_ml: hmm that's interesting. Is this across all datasets or a particular holdout?

alex_k: only on web-search-holdout and a tiny internal support-ticket set. not on long-doc benchmark.

sam_ops: did the tokenization or preprocessing change in the PTQ path? different seqlen/trim?

alex_k: preprocess pipeline is the same AFAIK. same tokenizer/version. quant pipeline only touches weights. eval-bot: evaluation job finished: https://ci.internal/runs/8921 (includes per-query deltas, anchoring plots).

jin_ee: quick glance at the per-query deltas: the top affected queries are very short (1-3 tokens) and frequently end with "." or "?" — looks like prefix kv-cache mismatches might reorder scores for short queries.

maria_ml: can you paste a tiny repro? even 5 queries would help. also check whether fp16->int8 simulates any cast rounding that affects logit ties.

alex_k: repro snippet:```python
queries = ["install error.", "how to reset?", "reboot server"]
run_rerank(model='reranker-v12-ptq', docs=topk)
# compare with model='reranker-v12-fp16'
```

alex_k: note: when I manually strip trailing punctuation before rerank, numbers recover to baseline.

sam_ops: so maybe tokenizer outputs different subtokens when punctuation present -> different attention patterns -> kv indices shift. Try forcing tokenizer.normalize_punctuation=False or keep_whitespace flag.

jin_ee: also check kv cache offset bug we saw in 2025-07 (small shift only for length<=3 queries). I can run a quick kernel-level smoke with PTQ weights.

maria_ml: ok next steps: (1) alex, share 100 affected queries + labels, (2) sam, run tokenizer diff on these queries, (3) jin, run kv-cache smoke on PTQ variant. I'll try an analytic: measure fraction of cases where top-1 changes due to score ties.

alex_k: uploaded sample set to /mnt/eval_artifacts/punct_regress_1768.json and added labels. ping me if you need access. :thumbsup:

eval-bot: rerank-diff job queued for jin_ee (priority: high).

sam_ops: quick sanity: run full eval with --force-single-thread on PTQ to eliminate nondeterministic batching effects. that caught us before.

jin_ee: running now. ETA ~12m. will post logs.

maria_ml: thanks team. if this is reproducible on PTQ only we should add a targeted unit test for short-question punctuation cases in the eval gauntlet before rollout.

alex_k: agreed. adding ticket in Jira: ML-1482. tagging @sam_ops for test infra.

sam_ops: got it. I'll also add tokenizer checksum into the artifact metadata so future rollouts fail fast.

alex_k: great. will wait for jin's kernel smoke and then decide whether to hold the PTQ release.
